name: RESTORE BODY
originalText:
#### RESTORE BODY

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Battle Scars
- **Source Page:** 4

```text
Target One creature you can reach
You touch the target, and it heals damage equal to its
healing rate. If you concentrate for 1 minute, during which
time you maintain contact with the target, you restore one
missing extremity, organ, or limb.
```

name: UNSPEAKABLE GRAFT
originalText:
#### UNSPEAKABLE GRAFT

- **Type:** Utility
- **Source:** Battle Scars
- **Source Page:** 4

```text
Requirements You must have a body part such as an eye,
ﬁnger, hand, or leg harvested from a living creature that
is still alive
Target One creature you can reach
You touch the body part you harvested as described in the
spell’s requirement to the place where it is missing from the
target’s body. If you concentrate for 1 minute, during which
time you maintain contact with the target, you graft the body
part to the target’s body, allowing the target to make full
use of the part. The grafted body part might have unusual
characteristics, such as claws, the ability to see in the dark,
and so on; such beneﬁts are conferred to the target creature.
The creature from which the body part was harvested
still receives information from the
part such that it can feel what the
grafted hand feels, see what the
grafted eye sees. While this
can have a variety of
beneﬁts, it causes the
creature great mental
distress. Whenever the
creature completes
a rest, it must
get a success on
a Will challenge
roll with 1 bane or
gain 1d3 Insanity.
If the target
creature is not
missing the body
part you would
graft to it, you
must remove
the appropriate
part ﬁrst for the
spell to have an
effect.
Sacriﬁce You
can expend
a casting of
this spell to
cast the part
bone from
ﬂesh spell from
the Forbidden
tradition.
```
